messages:
maria (PM): quick sync — proposing a small "exposure/probe" discovery endpoint that clients call to learn model runtime capabilities (tools, streaming, JSON output support, token limits). need minimal launch contract and criteria. @alex can you sketch the minimal shape we need?

alex (Eng - runtime): agree — keep it intentionally small. minimal fields: `id`, `supports_streaming`, `streaming_modes`, `supports_tools` (ids only), `structured_output_formats`, `max_request_tokens`, `rate_limits`. example response shape we discussed:```json
{
  \"id\": \"redwood-v1-large\",
  \"supports_streaming\": true,
  \"streaming_modes\": [\"token\", \"event\"],
  \"supports_tools\": [\"web_search\", \"json_schema_validator\"],
  \"structured_output_formats\": [\"json_schema_v1\"],
  \"max_request_tokens\": 16384,
  \"rate_limits\": { \"per_minute\": 1200, \"burst\": 300 }
}
```

jin (ML): two ML points: 1) streaming should distinguish between partial-token vs chunked events (clients need to know if they can start incremental decode). propose `streaming_semantics: \"partial_tokens\" | \"event_frames\"`. 2) `supports_tools` should include a small capability vector per-tool (can it run sync vs async, requires input schema). example: `web_search:{invocation: \"async\"}` — but keep it optional to avoid churn.

tayla (DevEx): SDK ergonomics: please keep flag names stable and namespaced: `cap_streaming`, `cap_tools`, `cap_structured_output`. prefer kebab or snake? we use snake in SDKs. also add `client_feature_map` to map capability -> recommended SDK config (e.g., enable_streaming: true). helps with autoconfig.

chen (Security): important: do NOT expose internal tool endpoints in discovery. only expose canonical tool ids + high-level invocation modes. add `policy_class` and `data_residency` tags where relevant. and cap reporting — avoid publishing exact remaining token balance for privacy; `max_request_tokens` is ok.

sam (Customer Success): customers keep asking for absolute clarity on token limits for enterprise (they enforce by contract). we should add `per_tenant_overrides_supported: true|false` and `reported_limit_granularity: \"upper_bound\" | \"exact\"`. enterprise launch customers want `exact`.

infra-bot: canary rollout scheduled for 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC for feature: exposure-probe v1 -> 5% traffic. see runbook link: https://go/runbooks/exposure-probe-canary

alex (Eng - runtime): to reconcile: proposal for v1 schema (minimal):```json
{
  \"id\": \"string\",
  \"cap_streaming\": true/false,
  \"streaming_modes\": [\"token\" | \"event\"],
  \"streaming_semantics\": \"partial_tokens\" | \"event_frames\",
  \"cap_tools\": [\"tool_id\"],
  \"structured_output\": [\"json_schema_v1\"],
  \"max_request_tokens\": number,
  \"rate_limits\": [\"per_minute:number\", \"burst:number\"],
  \"per_tenant_overrides_supported\": true/false
}
```

maria (PM): great — draft launch criteria from product side: 1) endpoint live in staging + docs, 2) SDK auto-detect + fallback logic implemented, 3) telemetry emitted (capability probe success/fail, mismatch rate), 4) e2e quality checks for structured outputs + streaming, 5) privacy/security review signed off, 6) beta with 3 enterprise customers and one open-source client. after that: 10% prod rollout, monitor 72h.

alex (Eng - runtime): engineering checklist: backwards-compatible schema (v1), deprecation header plan, server-side cache TTL for probe responses, fast path for health-checks, tests for fallback when unsupported capability requested.

jin (ML): also add eval hooks: when client declares `structured_output:json_schema_v1`, we run schema conformance evals for a small set of prompts and record regression alerts.

tayla (DevEx): I'll draft SDK PR template and migration guide once schema is final. prefer to avoid flag churn during beta.

chen (Security): will schedule compliance review; need to verify audit events and KMS handling for any tool invocation metadata.

sam (Customer Success): I'll line up the 3 enterprise beta customers and gather their must-have checks (exact token visibility, per-tenant overrides).

maria (PM): next steps: @alex + @jin + @tayla + @chen sync tomorrow. i'll push a short RFC to the repo with the v1 schema and launch checklist. thanks all :thumbsup:
